title: The $1.3 Billion Pizza
why_movie: RESULT: a stated sum - the 10,000 Bitcoin he took for two pizzas in 2010 is worth $1.3 billion today, his own words. METHOD: he chose to take the coin instead of the $41 cash, betting on something nobody else believed in yet, before there was any proof. WISH: a stranger wants the 14 audios to learn how to make that same kind of decision - acting on conviction before the world agrees - in their own life.
start_words: In 2010, the first purchase using Bitcoin happened

payoff: It's not what you know, it's who you know
caption:
Comment "WISH" and I'll send you Kevin Trudeau's 14 Your Wish Is Your Command audios. Free.

Kevin Trudeau says back in 2010 he offered a Papa John's owner 10,000 Bitcoin for two pizzas. The owner wanted the $41 in cash instead - Bitcoin was brand new, and nobody trusted it yet.

Kevin talked him into taking the coins. Six months later, they were worth $10,000.

What they're worth today is the part nobody believes.

{episode}

The 14 audios teach how to use your mind to decide before the proof ever shows up - the same decision that turned two pizzas into a fortune.

Most people will scroll past this. A few will comment "WISH" and start tonight.
